THE ECHO OF WORDS YOU NEVER SPOKE ALOUD
JUST A WHISPER ON THE TIDE'S LONG RETURN
poetryFrame.rightVertical:
LEARNING TO SEE BEYOND YOUR FADING PLANS
FINDING STRENGTH IN THIS QUIET, EMPTY SPACE
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THE TRUTH IS ALWAYS FOUND IN SILENCE.
sonnetLines: The tide pulls back the fragile thread,
A lesson learned in empty air;
No longer haunted by what was said,
Or promises that weren't truly there.
I watch the light begin to climb,
Across a vast and vacant blue;
Leaving behind the weight of time,
And all the things I thought were true.
The echo fades, the vision clears,
I stand alone upon the stone,
My own self-worth is fully known.
